facts.fact: The Secretary of State for Finance presents the Portal do Munícipe as a Ministry of Finance tool, run with the finance ministry's SETIC-FP IT service, that the municipalities use.

The Portal is a web service at municipal.minfin.gov.ao, reached through the internet, with 547 services, so the record is held in the Ministry of Finance's system and not in each municipality; the article dates the briefing to November 2021 (published 2021-11-17).

systems.tiers: installed in almost all of the 164 municipal seats and some communal seats
